adjudicator.method: Full-stem adjudication against the most-specific-concept and material-additional-placement rules after receiving two blind independent reviews

decisions.rationale: The task compares dated trade, invisibles and capital-account balances, so the balance-of-payments accounting framework is primary and both component accounts are independently material.

The question tests a dated agricultural-growth statistic and the contributing subsectors; the Eleventh Plan supplies the period rather than independently testing plan policy, and livestock is one answer component rather than a separate conceptual task.
The dated comparison is principally about health indicators, while infant mortality, maternal mortality and institutional delivery make maternal and child health independently material.

The complete statement set tests the administrative, military, sanitary and built-environment functions of colonial hill stations. The new bounded settlement-history leaf is primary and the explicit architectural-style statement justifies a material additional placement.
The question identifies the Senia lineage as a Hindustani tradition; Tansen explains the name but does not create a separate forms-and-composers task.
The question asks which sporting discipline Vikas Gowda competes in; it tests athlete-to-discipline identity, not a dated result, record, rule or venue.
